title: Mixing: Cleanup Time by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

A mixing session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 8 October 1980.

This session saw work on Lennon’s song ‘Cleanup Time’. The song had been recorded on 13 August and 5 and 17 September 1980.

This day’s mixes were not used, however, as the song was remixed on 17 and 19 October.
